task: Replace name-sensitive generic lowering and verify the accepted diagnostic on a generic raising call.
observation: The backend skipped generic classification for any function whose name contained the word 'generic', even when SemanticChecker had marked its signature generic. Removing the name test made the generic_score function use the macro lowering path. A focused structured differential also found Java reported an escaping typed error at the call expression while C++ reports the main declaration line.
impact: Function naming affected generated Rust selection, and the structured differential exposed a precise diagnostic location mismatch without invoking native acceptance. Using checker facts and the main declaration location produced stable, source-backed decisions.

resolution.summary: Generic lowering now uses checker/type facts rather than the function name, and escaping typed errors from main use the same diagnostic line as C++. Focused generated-Rust inspection and the three-file structured differential pass.

task: Audit Java sort lowering against the accepted user-function shadowing and generic-key behaviors.
observation: A locally defined function named sort was accepted and selected by Java Fast Debug, but NativeGenerator lowered its call as the builtin in-place sort. Adding a user-function guard fixes the dispatch. A separate untyped String key probe shows the Java backend passes cloned owned MossStr values to both specialized comparator calls.
impact: The mismatch could make accepted source fail native Rust compilation or behave as an invalid builtin invocation. The focused generated-source regression now covers dispatch and the owned generic-key argument shape; Rust compilation remains unverified until the candidate gate.
evidence: tmp/phase25-3-semantic/sort_shadow.moss (before fix generated builtin .sort_by for user function)
C++/Java Fast Debug output for sort_shadow.moss is 7 then 3

resolution.summary: Builtin Rust lowering now defers to a same-named user function. Unit regression covers this and owned values for both untyped String key operands; native compilation is still pending.
